notes: Summary: Mid-market product company building an AI assistant and document search feature. Currently running Hosted API trial (monthly credits). Primary path: hosted -> dedicated reserve if SLA/latency and unit economics make sense.
Discovery call (2024-11-05) w/ PM + infra: interested in Dedicated for predictable latency during PLG expansion. Emphasis on multi-tenant isolation and VPC peering.

Hosted trial (2024-11-10 -> ongoing): they replayed a 72h sample of production traffic. Observed baseline throughput and token mix below. Want final Dedicated sizing once we validate 2-week soak results.
Quote from PM: 'We need consistent 95th pct latency under 300ms for chat, and <100ms P50 for embeddings/rerank requests.'
Procurement: legal sent initial security questionnaire (SEC-8821). CSM Nora coordinating SSO and SOC2 artifact exchange.

Competitive: evaluated OpenAI for simplicity but flagged egress and enterprise controls; Anthropic shortlisted for safety profile. Internal infra team evaluating self-hosted option but worried about ops overhead.
timeline: 2024-11-10 Hosted trial started — traffic replay job executed
capacity_summary: Observed trial metrics (72h replay): average QPS: 12, peak sustained QPS: 48 (5 min window), typical concurrent websocket sessions: 18 active, burst concurrency seen: 62 for short periods.

Token mix (sample): avg tokens/request = 420 (prompt 30% / generate 70%). Embeddings calls are low-frequency but high-cost per-request (avg 1,100 tokens). Reranking requests are short (<150 tokens) but latency sensitive.
Latency targets: internal requirement P95 chat <300ms, P50 embeddings <100ms. Hosted P95 observed = 260ms during non-peak, spiking to 520ms at peak QPS in trial window.

Forecast assumptions: 3x QPS growth over 6 months from PLG activation; baseline production target for Dedicated sizing: steady-state QPS 36, peak QPS 110, steady concurrency 60, peak concurrency 180 (5-10% of sessions heavy-generation).

Dedicated sizing recommendation (initial): 2 x high-memory GPUs (A100 80GB class) with autoscale policy to add 2 more GPUs for peak bursts OR 4 x A10s with intelligent routing + KV cache for chat to reduce generation cost. Team prefers A100 class for token-heavy generation and long context support.
Caching & batching notes: enabling prefix/KV caching for chat expected to reduce generation tokens by ~18-25% for repeated flows; Redwood Optimize suggestions pending after longer soak.
Estimated monthly token volume at forecast: ~1.6B tokens/month (prompt+generate), unit cost sensitivity flagged — procurement asking for committed discount tiers and burst allowances.

Operational requirements: VPC peering, customer-managed KMS for secret keys, audit logging retention 13 months, SAML SSO for admin console. Data residency: primary NA, failover to EU only for DR (must confirm egress path).

Estimated ARR scenarios: conservative $150k (small reserve), base $220k, expanded $300k+ with multi-region routing and higher commit.
